hypothesis: Canonicalizing full isomeric SMILES before graph construction removes representation changes arising from raw atom chiral tags under equivalent SMILES.
observation: Raw Chemprop validation consistency changed on equivalent-SMILES queries; initial inspected mismatches were chiral and predicted logx changed by0.06–0.35dex, exceeding ordinary floating-point noise.
control: Same completed checkpoints, CPU, query cohort, temperature scalers, batch size and decoder; only canonicalize solute/solvent query SMILES before graph construction. Preserve stereo/charge/fragments.
criterion: Report all three seeds and both protocols. Exact agreement and prediction changes are measured; do not claim canonicalization as method novelty.
scope: Validation only; no target values used.
source: Installed Chemprop2.3.1 featurizer source, GetChiralTag feature; code-level association rather than a causal chemistry claim.
